done.why: I had seen a dragon, a wizard and a disorienting room, and had no clear goal. I stopped after a short wander.

about: A cave-exploring adventure that starts in a barrow. There are treasures south of a ravine, a meddling wizard, a dragon, and a disorienting carousel room. I never found a goal.

moments.note: The wizard appeared, hinted that treasure lies south, and made me drop the lamp.
Moving south into the dark gave a grue warning, and I had to guess to turn the lamp on.
The carousel room would not let me pick a direction.
The dragon room, and the dragon just watched me.

wished: Some sign of what I was supposed to do.
A way to understand the dragon.

lines.line: It is all south of the ravine, his look says, every treasure the Empire mislaid, and much good may it do you.
lines.why: It was the only hint of a goal.

fun.why: Exploring was pleasant, but I had no goal.

engagement.why: The dragon and the wizard were intriguing, but I left early.

difficulty.why: Simple commands worked. The dark and the carousel room were a little confusing.

interestingness.why: The setting has a lot in it: wizard, dragon, frescoes, bridges.

prose.why: The descriptions were clear and atmospheric, and the wizard's look was nicely written.
